source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and c > 0 and c < w - 1)
    left = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
    right = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]
    left_bg = Counter(x for row in left for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    right_bg = Counter(x for row in right for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    left_fg = next(x for row in left for x in row if x != left_bg)
    right_fg = next(x for row in right for x in row if x != right_bg)
    out = [[left_fg for _ in range(divider)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(divider):
            if left[r][c] == left_fg and right[r][c] == right_fg:
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''

    for r in range(h):
